lines.text: In our village, nobody checks the weather forecast on a smartphone.
lines.caps: IN OUR VILLAGE, | NOBODY *CHECKS | THE *WEATHER FORECAST

lines.text: Look at that crow flying sideways! In five minutes, a massive storm is coming!
lines.caps: LOOK AT THAT CROW! | IN FIVE *MINUTES, | MASSIVE *STORM COMING!

lines.text: Rahat immediately panicked and rushed to fill every bucket at the tube well.
lines.caps: RAHAT *PANICKED | AND RUSHED TO FILL | EVERY *BUCKET!

lines.text: Why are you sweating like a madman under the afternoon sun?
lines.caps: WHY ARE YOU *SWEATING | UNDER THE *AFTERNOON SUN?

lines.text: Chacha said his joints are aching, and that always means heavy rain!
lines.caps: CHACHA'S *JOINTS ARE ACHING, | THAT ALWAYS MEANS | HEAVY *RAIN!

lines.text: Chacha's joints only ache when the tea bill is about to arrive.
lines.caps: HIS JOINTS ONLY *ACHE | WHEN THE *TEA BILL | IS ABOUT TO *ARRIVE.

lines.text: And just like that, the storm never came... and neither did Chacha's money.
lines.caps: THE STORM *NEVER CAME... | AND NEITHER DID | CHACHA'S *MONEY.
